content: {"like":["Box art nice with yellow background and reversible image featuring all 10 Sailor Guardians","Poster and postcard distributed at AX 2016 and Otakon 2016","Standard art gallery, textless opening and ending, trailers and cast interviews as bonus features","Solid performance by the English cast, especially Cristie‑Marie Cabanos as Hotaru Tomoe/Mistress 9/Sailor Saturn","Keith Silverstein’s portrayal of Professor Tomoe and Kenji Tsukino","Unique and distinct voices in the Cloverway dub for the Witches 5","Good picture quality with sharp lines and bright colors when viewed from a distance"],"dislike":["Similar, generic voices for Mimete, Tellu, Viluy and Cyprine in the ViZ dub, making them hard to distinguish","Generic scream for Cyprine and Ptilol in the ViZ dub lacking the lingering effect of the Cloverway dub","Grain and ghosting visible when viewing the Blu‑ray from a close distance","Overall lack of distinctiveness in the ViZ dub compared to the Cloverway dub"]}
